visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 2 main female creators/presenters throughout the video.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: Woman A has long dark hair, wearing a black beret, a light-colored vest over a purple long-sleeve shirt. Woman B has short dark hair, wearing a blue beret and a voluminous yellow puffer jacket.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The video starts in a night parking lot in front of a Costco store with a large lit logo. It transitions to an indoor home setting with a modern living room featuring a brown sofa and white walls. There's a kitchen counter area, a laundry machine area, and an office desk with two monitors and a keyboard. A festive CGI background with fireworks and traditional lanterns is used at the end.
visual_scene_and_style.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens at night in a Costco parking lot. Two women (A and B) stand in the foreground; Woman B holds a small white dog. A large Costco logo is superimposed at the top. (2) The scene shifts indoors. Woman A holds multiple bottles of Lysol Laundry Sanitizer, showing difficulty carrying them to emphasize their weight. She then demonstrates pouring the blue liquid into a washing machine's detergent tray. (3) Woman B is seen at a kitchen counter. She holds a carton of Koh Coconut Water and a glass jar of Moccona Coffee. She mixes the two with milk into a glass with ice, showing the finished 'Coconut Americano.' (4) Both women appear together holding boxes of Weider Lutein. They show the yellow powder inside a sachet by pouring it onto a small plate. Woman B is then shown working at a desk with dual monitors, taking the supplement. (5) The final phase features both women in front of a festive Chinese New Year CGI background with fireworks and red lanterns, posing with 'eye' gestures.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with an upbeat acoustic guitar melody and high-energy female Chinese dialogue. A sharp 'Pop' SFX triggers as the main topic is introduced. (2) A 'Whoosh' SFX marks the transition as the speaker describes Lysol sanitizer with rapid, excited speech. The background music remains consistent with a steady percussive beat. (3) A bubbly 'Pop' SFX occurs as the scene changes to the beverage section. The vocal tone is persuasive and cheerful. Sounds of liquid pouring are subtly layered under the speech and music. (4) A 'Ding' SFX introduces the third product, Lutein. The dialogue becomes more informative but maintains high arousal. Subtle digital 'click' SFX are heard as the visuals show computer use. (5) The music swells slightly as the speakers deliver a final enthusiastic recommendation and holiday blessing. The audio remains clean with studio-quality clarity and high signal-to-noise ratio.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Item 1 (Household) -> Item 2 (F&B) -> Item 3 (Health) -> Closing/CTA.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a promotional endorsement for Costco's online shopping platform. The creators recommend three specific products (laundry sanitizer, coconut water/coffee, and eye health supplements) to demonstrate the convenience of having heavy or essential items delivered directly to the home, targeting families and busy professionals.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct presentation of branded products with price information and usage instructions, while explicitly mentioning online shopping benefits.

social_sociology_tags.uniqueSignatures: High-energy duo presentation style; frequent use of variety-show style large text overlays; recurring white dog as a mascot.
social_sociology_tags.freeDescribe: The video uses typical social-native editing with fast cuts and sound effects to maintain high viewer engagement. The transition from real-world locations to a festive CGI background at the end suggests it was produced for the Chinese New Year period.
